mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.no, o.status, o.commit_date, o.company_id FROM ord_order o WHERE o.id IN #{id} ORDER BY o.no
mapper.sql: SELECT oi.order_id, o.no AS order_no, s.code AS style_code, k.code AS style_sku_code, b.tech_pack_id, b.seq AS bom_seq, b.source, b.supplier_id, b.material_id, m.code AS material_code, bs.material_sku_id AS sku_id, oi.qty, CASE WHEN b.usage_mode = 'BY_SIZE' THEN bz.usage_qty ELSE b.usage_qty END AS usage, b.loss_pct FROM ord_order_item oi JOIN ord_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = oi.style_id JOIN sty_style_sku k ON k.id = oi.style_sku_id

LEFT JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = b.material_id LEFT JOIN tp_bom_item_sku bs ON bs.bom_item_id = b.id AND bs.color_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN b.sku_mode IN ('BY_COLOR', 'BY_COLOR_SIZE') THEN k.color_id END) AND bs.size_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN b.sku_mode IN ('BY_SIZE', 'BY_COLOR_SIZE') THEN k.size_code END) LEFT JOIN tp_bom_item_size bz ON bz.bom_item_id = b.id AND bz.size_code = k.size_code
mapper.select:
LEFT JOIN tp_bom_item b ON b.tech_pack_id = oi.tech_pack_id
WHERE oi.qty > 0 AND oi.order_id IN #{id} ORDER BY oi.order_id, oi.seq, b.seq

JOIN (VALUES (#{p.styleId}::bigint, #{p.packId}::bigint)) AS pk(style_id, pack_id) ON pk.style_id = oi.style_id LEFT JOIN tp_bom_item b ON b.tech_pack_id = pk.pack_id
WHERE oi.qty > 0 AND oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.seq, b.seq

SELECT oi.order_id, s.code AS style_code FROM ord_order_item oi JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = oi.style_id WHERE oi.qty > 0 AND oi.order_id IN #{id} GROUP BY oi.order_id, s.code ORDER BY oi.order_id, min(oi.seq)
SELECT co.calc_id, o.id AS order_id, o.no AS order_no, o.commit_date FROM mrp_calc_order co JOIN ord_order o ON o.id = co.order_id WHERE co.calc_id IN #{id} ORDER BY co.calc_id, o.no

SELECT co.order_id, c.id AS calc_id, c.no AS calc_no, c.status, c.close_reason, c.create_by FROM mrp_calc_order co JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = co.calc_id WHERE co.order_id IN #{id} ORDER BY co.order_id, c.id
